nodes.label: Admin scripts import cleanly: main() is behind isDirectRun
A count baked into an item name becomes qty, so it can be spent one at a time
Descriptive parentheticals are not counts — the trap a naive number-in-parens regex falls into
repairInventory is idempotent — a second pass over repaired data changes nothing
Repair merges into an existing entry rather than creating a duplicate name
Stacked copies of a baked-count item multiply out (qty 3 of "vials (2)" becomes 6)
Name matching is case-insensitive, mirroring engine.removeItem
Rewind cuts at the Nth-from-last player entry, keeping system entries that belong to a kept turn
Over-rewinding clamps to index 0 instead of producing a negative cut
The waiting row states target + expression only — a long reason can never push it off
The revealed row never includes the reason, so the numbers can never be truncated away
Pass/fail verdict carries a colour: green ✓ SUCCESS, red ✗ FAILURE
After a luck reroll both totals show as plain numbers, no per-die detail
The idle summary reflects the kept (post-reroll) total, not the first roll
With no DC the vs/verdict clause is omitted entirely rather than rendered empty
The dice card is a fixed 3-row card (2 rows truncated the numbers off)
storyHeight + DICE_AREA_HEIGHT + INPUT_BAR_HEIGHT is exactly `rows`, at every supported size
Story height never drops below 1, even for a pathologically small terminal
Wrapping breaks on word boundaries; only an over-long single word is hard-split
Existing newlines and blank lines survive wrapping as separate groups
The viewport returns exactly `height` lines — padded with blanks, never over budget
At scrollOffset 0 the newest content is always the last line
scrollOffset is clamped so the view can never scroll past the top into emptiness
The "newer text below" indicator counts toward the height budget, not on top of it
Player lines get "> " once; continuations indent to align instead of repeating it
Wrapped lines memoize per (entry id, width) and re-wrap when width changes
An access code survives keystroke-by-keystroke sanitising in code mode
PIN mode still strips non-digits and caps at 6 characters
The exact corruption is pinned as a test so nobody reinstates the unconditional digit filter
authMode defaults to the permissive 'code', so every failure path fails open
Importing serve.ts binds no socket and registers no signal handlers
Config precedence is env > CLI flag > default, with blank/whitespace env treated as unset
A non-numeric or non-positive port (flag or env) is ignored rather than crashing the boot
--no-pin beats GAME_PIN: an explicitly open server is never silently re-locked
An operator-supplied GAME_PIN is never echoed into the startup banner, only its length
A locally generated PIN IS printed — the console is the only place it exists
hello() is the single reconnect-resume snapshot composing every controller callback
onDiceRoll is inert: a roll reaches the client as an in-sequence 'roll' story entry, never a resurrectable snapshot field
detach() resets everything; a fresh attach() never inherits the old session's entries or state
Sanitized state exposes only character + world, is function-free, and JSON round-trips
A snapshot is a point-in-time copy: later in-place Engine mutation cannot rewrite it retroactively
Every event fans out to all subscribers and stops immediately on unsubscribe
Each ControllerCallbacks method maps to one pinned SSE event name and payload shape
Suggestion chips are scene-scoped: mirrored into hello() for reconnect, cleared on act, empty on fresh attach, immutable through the snapshot
Ledger gains are transient like system notes — broadcast once, never replayed by hello()
Locally appended system entries take negative ids so they never collide with controller-driven ones
The HTTP suite injects a fake controller so no real DmSession/Agent SDK is ever spawned
index.html is served no-cache + ETag so a phone cannot pin itself to a stale login screen
A matching If-None-Match answers 304 with an empty body, keeping revalidation cheap
Every data route is PIN-gated while GET / stays open, so the login screen can always load
The SSE route alone accepts the credential as a query param, because EventSource cannot set headers
Lockout is per-IP, not per-guess: after N failures even the correct PIN 429s, and success resets the counter
A second /api/continue or /api/new while a session is live 409s and constructs no second controller
/api/end shuts the controller down and clears the session, and is a harmless no-op when idle
Slash commands render as system entries locally and never reach submitPlayerAction
Web command text points at web affordances — no PgUp hint, no "npm run play", Retire Hero not TUI-only
/api/presets derives from newCampaign.ts, never hardcoded client data
The terminal wizard's empty-seed 'custom' theme row is excluded from the web presets
Stat rolling is server-authoritative 4d6-drop-lowest, six values in 3..18, rerollable
Invalid campaign creation input 400s and constructs no controller at all
Retire swaps in a new hero on the SAME campaign slug and leaves an "A new hero rises" transcript note
Errors return JSON with no stack-trace leakage, and the server survives a malformed request
The shared PIN stops being a credential the moment any player exists
Auth flips pin→code the instant the first player is registered, with no restart
/api/auth-mode answers without a credential and leaks nothing but the mode
An access code is accepted with or without its dashes
Authorisation IS the save path: a player sees and opens only their own campaigns
A traversal slug (../alice/precious) 400s — savePaths containment is the only guard
Sessions are per-player: two live at once, and the 409/end only ever apply to the caller
Shutdown drains every player's controller, so SIGTERM autosaves everyone, not whoever was last
One player's narration and state never reach another player's SSE stream
Delete moves the campaign to .deleted rather than destroying it, and .deleted is never listed
Deleting the campaign being played shuts the session first, or autosave recreates the folder
SSE tickets are opaque, single-use, and issuer-scoped — which is why EventSource's built-in retry cannot be used
The SSE collector uses one overall deadline, not a per-chunk timer that silently dropped late frames

hyperedges.label: Pure-core testing: direct-run guards and injected factories keep the suite from booting real I/O or an Agent SDK session
Per-player isolation boundary: the save path is the authorisation, across listing, sessions, SSE, deletion and shutdown
A roll's numbers are always visible where the roll happened, on both the terminal and web paths
